title: Historic-site / park interpreter
summary: Lead walks, explain historic places and artifacts, develop interpretive experiences for visitors.
firstSteps: Request a volunteer docent shift at Pío Pico
Observe a complete tour, including setup and cleanup
Confirm eligibility before applying for a paid classification

title: Museum educator / public programs
summary: Create tours, workshops, school visits and public events, sometimes with on-site demonstration.
firstSteps: Volunteer with Gilb Museum or another small institution
Deliver a supervised 10-minute object talk
Look for public-program assistant and visitor education titles

title: Auction-house / consignment operations
summary: Handle physical consignments, research objects, support sales, and work with collectors, estates and buyers.
firstSteps: Attend a John Moran public auction preview
Ask about receiving, preview or cataloging entry roles
Learn condition reports and simple provenance research

title: Coins / numismatics / bullion dealer
summary: Buy, evaluate and sell coins and precious metals, combining market literacy with security and customer service.
firstSteps: Attend a local coin show
Speak with established dealers about junior roles
Practice grading only with supervision and inexpensive materials

title: Botanical garden guide / horticultural assistant
summary: Work with plants, visitors, garden tours, grounds or nursery collections.
firstSteps: Try California Botanic Garden volunteering
Compare a guide shift with a grounds shift
Record enjoyment of repetitive tasks and weather exposure

title: Parks & recreation coordinator
summary: Deliver youth, senior, community and outdoor programs through a city or park department.
firstSteps: Apply to recreation leader roles
Build documented hours supervising programs
Target coordinator openings after qualifying experience

title: Private tutoring / adult instruction
summary: Teach an existing area of real competence in-person or in small groups.
firstSteps: Offer two supervised or low-stakes practice sessions
Choose a subject with demonstrated mastery
Measure results and desire to repeat the experience

title: Rare-book buyer / antiquarian bookseller
summary: Research editions, bindings, provenance and condition; acquire, catalog and sell collectible books.
firstSteps: Visit an antiquarian bookseller
Study and document five editions of one title
Seek mentorship or entry-level cataloging work

title: E-commerce operations and fulfillment
summary: Keep Shopify/WordPress experience in play through inventory, digital merchandising, physical goods and team operations.
firstSteps: Visit a local fulfillment operation and search for on-site operations coordinator roles
movement: Medium to high depending on location

title: Shopify / WordPress site administration
summary: Manage listings, merchandising, product content and customer processes without complex software engineering.
firstSteps: Prepare two storefront improvements as portfolio examples

title: Field IT support and technical training
summary: Hands-on PC troubleshooting, installing devices and training people at real workplaces rather than extensive programming.
firstSteps: Explore IT field support roles and compare actual walking and travel duties

title: No-code / CMS implementation consulting
summary: Configure systems and train customers with practical tools, keeping coding demands light.
firstSteps: Deliver a small real-world automation or documentation sample

title: Local history walking-tour business
summary: Build a research-led route and pilot a small paid historical tour outside central Los Angeles.
firstSteps: Run one free practice walk with feedback before attempting paid sales

title: Historic preservation / restoration trades
summary: Practical carpentry and site maintenance with heritage settings and tangible results.
firstSteps: Try a supervised woodworking or preservation volunteer day

title: Precious-metals and numismatic retail
summary: Work with gold, silver and coins through client service, valuation basics, controlled inventory and estate buying.
firstSteps: Interview a numismatic dealer and inspect typical daily duties

title: Technical documentation and training
summary: Turn existing technology understanding into clear instructions, support articles and guided training.
firstSteps: Write a concise troubleshooting guide for a real service process
